name: Heraldic Crest of Conviction
body:
A heraldic crest is a special enhancement that can be placed on a +1 shield or armor. Each heraldic crest grants a minor benefit to the wearer or wielder so long as they meet one of the following prerequisites:

Has the Leadership feat.
Has the aura class feature of the marshal class.
Has otherwise been granted the right to bear a crest by a liege or divine organization. GM determines whether this has occurred.

In addition to the minor benefit, each crest has a stronger ability usable once per day. Bearers can also expend their uses of inspire action, if applicable, to activate these abilities beyond the first use per day. A character can only have one heraldic crest active. If they possess more than one, they can only have one active and usable. A single shield and armor can only have one heraldic crest each; if another is applied to the same item, the previous one vanishes. The exact iconography of the heraldic crest is unique to the bearer.

Price 11,080 gp; Aura moderate evocation; CL 7; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

The bearer gains a +1 morale bonus to saves against chaotic spells.

Once per day, on command, the bearer can cast order’s wrath centered on them.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 5,540 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells order’s wrath
